fields.subject: FW: Final Access Control and Account Revocation — Halden-support Account
fields.note:
VP Haskell, Anil —

This is the final confirmation from TSA. The halden-support account has been permanently revoked and will not be reactivated under any circumstances. All remote access to the OT network will remain disabled until the full CISA forensic review is complete and a signed access request is submitted by the Incident Commander.

We have coordinated with Halden Automation to ensure no configuration restoration will occur until CISA and TSA jointly confirm the environment is secure.

Please proceed with the formal review process under CVG-CIRP-2026 Section 10.

—R. Thompson
fields.signature:
R. Thompson
Pipeline Security Division
TSA Office of Pipeline Safety

original.subject: Final Access Control and Account Revocation — Halden-support Account
original.body:
VP Haskell, Anil,

The halden-support account has been permanently revoked. New MFA credentials have been issued to CVG staff for remote access. All remote access to the OT network will only resume after: (1) a full audit of the jump host logs by CISA, (2) a signed access request from the Incident Commander, and (3) a review by the Cybersecurity Coordinator. The vendor Halden Automation will not restore any configuration until CISA and TSA confirm the environment is secure.

—TSA Contact: R. Thompson, Pipeline Security Division
